comment: Hand-written, and in a directory of its own so that re-running the agent
cannot overwrite it -- `nativeImageMetadata` writes only to the sibling
`goldberry-example` directory (ADR-0156). native-image reads every
META-INF/native-image/** it finds, so the two are merged for it and kept
apart for us.
logback.xml is here because the agent records it as a CLASSPATH resource:
logback asks a ClassLoader for it, and that is what the agent sees. In the
image the showcase runs on the module path, so the file lives at the root of
a named module and has to be registered against that module or it is simply
not there. The symptom is a silent image: with no configuration found,
logback ends up with no appenders and prints nothing at all -- not even its
own status.
libgoldberry is here because the agent cannot have seen it: the trace runs
with -Dgoldberry.native.library pointing at the build tree, which is the
branch of NativeLibrary that does NOT read a resource. The image takes the
other branch -- unpack from the classpath -- so the library has to be
registered by hand or the one file the image is meant to be turns back into
two (ADR-0159).
A ** glob rather than this machine's classifier, so the same metadata is
right on all four targets.
The showcase's own stylesheet and documents are globbed for the same reason
the toolkit's are (ADR-0160): a screen the trace never opened contributes
nothing, and the symptom is an image that dies when somebody clicks the tab.
